พิจารณา ETOH 96% สำหรับสูตรน้ำหอมที่ยอมร: Consider ETOH 96% for perfume formulations that accept denatured ethanol. Check the denaturant type and amount, specifications and destination-market requirements, and test odour, clarity and stability with the actual formulation before selecting it.
พิจารณา ETOH 96% โดยตรวจชนิดและปริมาณสาร: Consider ETOH 96% by checking the denaturant type and amount, specifications and requirements of the cosmetic or body-mist formulation. Test it with the actual formulation before selecting it. Any concentration change requires a review of the formulation’s water balance.
พิจารณา ETOH 96% หรือ 99.9% โดยตรวจชนิดแ: Consider ETOH 96% or 99.9% by checking the denaturant type and amount, specifications and test results with the actual fragrance-spray formulation. A higher concentration does not establish better fragrance diffusion. The 99.9% option is relevant when the formulator has a defined water-content requirement.
เริ่มพิจารณา ETOH 96% สำหรับลูกค้างานน้ำ: For fragrance and cosmetic customers, start by considering ETOH 96% and checking the denaturant type and amount, specifications and results from tests with the actual formulation. Suitability cannot be assumed for every formulation. Food or pharmaceutical applications need a separate grade and document review; do not use denatured ETOH in food intended for consumption.
